verify_note: These sources were used as background for the texts in this app. Facts can change (laws are updated, rankings change every year), so please verify any fact or figure in an up-to-date source before you quote it in an exam or presentation. Where no URL is given, search for the title and author – we only list links we are confident are correct.
ai_statement: AI was used to brainstorm and generate initial exercises. All tasks should be checked, edited and adapted by the students before use.

how_to_use.title: Start with the background
how_to_use.text: Work through the Key Facts texts first. They give you the facts, examples and names you can use to support your arguments.

how_to_use.title: Build your vocabulary every day
how_to_use.text: Do one vocabulary set or flashcard deck a day. Learn collocations as chunks (e.g. “raise awareness”, “hold someone to account”), not single words.

how_to_use.title: Speak out loud – always
how_to_use.text: Speaking tasks only work if you actually speak. Use the timer, record yourself on your phone and listen back. Then use the self-assessment checklist honestly.

how_to_use.title: Practise with a partner
how_to_use.text: Role-plays, debates and dilemmas are designed for pairs or small groups. Take turns playing the examiner and ask the follow-up questions.

how_to_use.title: Fix your typical mistakes
how_to_use.text: The Language Workshop targets mistakes that German speakers often make. Note the ones you make and check for them in your recordings.

how_to_use.title: Simulate the exam
how_to_use.text: In the last weeks, do the Mini Exam Simulation regularly. Treat it seriously: no notes beyond your preparation, no pausing the timer.

how_to_use.title: Use the daily suggestion
how_to_use.text: The dashboard suggests a task every day and tracks your streak. Ten focused minutes a day beat a three-hour panic session before the exam.

exam_note: The Mini Exam Simulation is a practice format created for this app. It is NOT an official description of the Austrian oral Matura (Reifeprüfung). Formats, preparation times and assessment criteria can differ – always check the current official requirements with your teacher.
